registry-build.description: Build Ndop's registry with ndop build: validate, type-check, snapshot and write static JSON.

registry-e2e.description: Install-test the registry: publish @ndop/* to Verdaccio, then ng new, ndop init, ndop add and ng build per package manager (ADR-0015).

serve-site.description: Serve a built static site the way Cloudflare Pages does, for end-to-end tests.

docs-lighthouse.description: Run Lighthouse on every route of the built docs site and fail under the minimum score (ADR-0016).

agent-eval.description: Run the agent eval suite: headless Claude Code with only the Ndop MCP server builds each prompt in a fixture app, scored by ndop verify (ADR-0019).

update-e2e.description: Run the update fixture suite: ndop add an old version, apply local edits, ndop update, and check files, statuses, exit codes and the lockfile (ADR-0020).

primitives-api.description: Extract the headless primitives' API reference and spec.md contracts for the docs' Primitives section (ADR-0016, amendment 12).

visual.description: Run the visual regression tests with the browser in Playwright's Docker image, so screenshots match on every machine (ADR-0021).

size.description: Measure what each registry component adds to an app, gzipped, and fail over its budget (ADR-0021).

docs-guides.description: Check the docs guides against the registry: compile their TypeScript and Angular template blocks, validate their ndop.json and registry.json blocks, and check the directives, items and component links they name (ADR-0030).

docs-smoke.description: Check a deployed docs site: trailing-slash redirects, the 404 page, the registry index, a theme URL, the service worker, robots.txt and the sitemap (ADR-0028).

release-bootstrap.description: The one-time npm bootstrap before the first release: pack 0.0.0 placeholders of the packages not on npm yet and print the npm publish and npm trust commands; publish and trust only when asked (ADR-0028).

release-version.description: Version the npm packages for a release with changeset version, then pin the registry template to the new version (ADR-0028).

registry-template-export.description: Write a standalone copy of tools/registry-template, ready to push as the public template repository (ADR-0025).
